and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in…

and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of…

people.name: Akkub
people.line: Levite gatekeeper during the post-exilic period

people.name: Bakbukiah
people.line: A Levite who served in Jerusalem after the exile.

people.name: Mattaniah
people.line: Levite singer and gatekeeper during the time of Nehemiah.

people.name: Meshullam
people.line: A Levite gatekeeper during Nehemiah's time.

people.name: Talmon
people.line: Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylonian exile

translations.web: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were gatekeepers keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.
translations.bsb: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were gatekeepers who guarded the storerooms at the gates.
translations.kjv: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.
translations.asv: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the watch at the store-houses of the gates.
